business_summary: LX Holdings Corp., through its subsidiaries, provides various solutions for materials, components, and services in South Korea. The company is involved in natural resources development comprising operation of coal business, nickel mine development and operation, and supplying of crude palm oil through its plantations; trading of nickel, coal, and palm oil; new growth; sea and air freight; contract logistics; and express/e-commerce logistics consisting of export and import, and door-to-door services. It also offers window and door products consisting of plastic and aluminum windows and doors, and functional glass; decorative materials, such as flooring, wallcovering, and insulation materials; surface material products, including engineered stone and solid surface; differentiated products; materials for the interior and exterior of cars, including automotive fabrics, and standard and lightweight components; decorative furniture, advertisement, and home appliance films; LCD/OLED displays for TVs, laptops, and monitors; displays for smartphones, smartwatches, and AR/VR devices; driver IC and chip technology for automobile infotainment displays; and MCUs for refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners; as well as manufacturing/construction services. In addition, the company provides monomers, including methyl methacrylate, methacrylic acid, and butyl methacrylate; polymers, such as poly-methyl methacrylate; flat, coated, processed, and special functional glass; management consultation; and market intelligence. Further, it is involved in innovation of IT and business infrastructures; fostering of talent; AI and digital; hardware and materials; future mobility; and sustainable economy activities. LX Holdings Corp. was founded in 1947 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
